title: Treadwear Mileage Warranty Administration at the Northgate Tire Center
content:
# Treadwear mileage warranty administration

Where a package supports treadwear claims, the Northgate Tire Center processes the manufacturer's treadwear mileage warranty for tires on the package.

## Qualifying conditions

**Worn before the warranty miles.** A tire qualifies for a treadwear claim only when its remaining tread is at or below the package's treadwear claim tread depth while the miles driven are below the tire's treadwear warranty miles. The miles driven are the odometer on the claim visit's work order less the odometer recorded at installation.

**Proof of regular rotation.** The claim also requires proof of regular rotation: the largest gap in miles between consecutive odometer readings — taken in the order installation odometer, the odometer of every rotation entry on the package in date order, and the claim visit's odometer — may not exceed the package's largest rotation gap allowed for a claim.

Both conditions are read from the system's records: the installation odometer and treadwear warranty miles on the package, and the odometers of the rotation entries and the claim visit.

## Exclusions

- A tire model with treadwear warranty miles of zero has no treadwear warranty.
- Uneven wear caused by alignment or suspension faults is not a treadwear claim.
- A tire already replaced under road hazard protection is not a treadwear claim.

## Pricing of the claim

- **Credit — no longer in force.** The clause "the credit is the price paid per tire multiplied by the miles remaining on the warranty divided by the treadwear warranty miles, under the package's treadwear proration, rounded to the cent" is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis for the treadwear credit.
- The replacement of the same item is charged at the current tire price — the regular price in effect on the service date for the tire's item number on Northgate In-Club Purchase.
- **Fitting of the replacement — no longer in force.** The words providing that the replacement is "installed at the package's per-tire price" are no longer in force; they have been superseded by the current basis for the claim fitting charge.
- A credit is applied only to the replacement.

## Worked checks on hypothetical figures

**Tread and miles.** Treadwear warranty of 50000 miles, claim tread depth of 2/32 inch:

| Tread measured | Miles driven | Qualifies on these two counts |
|---|---|---|
| 2/32 | 49999 | yes |
| 2/32 | 50000 | no — the miles are not below the warranty |
| 3/32 | 30000 | no — the tread is above the claim depth |

**Rotation gaps.** Largest gap allowed 7500 miles; installation odometer 10000, rotation entries at 16000 and 23500:

| Claim visit odometer | Gaps in order | Largest gap | Proof of regular rotation |
|---|---|---|---|
| 31000 | 6000, 7500, 7500 | 7500 | shown (not above 7500) |
| 31001 | 6000, 7500, 7501 | 7501 | not shown |

superseded_clauses: installed at the package's per-tire price
The credit is tire_unit_price times the miles remaining on the warranty divided by treadwear_warranty_miles, per treadwear_proration_basis, rounded to the cent
